label: Research goal
text: I want to become a research scientist and publish papers. The plan: a first-author workshop paper within a year, then apply to research residencies.

label: Refund recall drop
text: I retrained the ticket-intent classifier on the June export and refund recall dropped from 0.81 to 0.62. Same config, same seed. I have no idea what changed yet.

label: Standup doubts
text: In standup everyone gives a crisp update and I say 'still digging into the classifier' for the fourth day in a row. I'm pretty sure I'm the only one on the team who doesn't know what they're doing.

label: Morning focus block
text: I do my best thinking from 9 to 11am, so I'm blocking that time on my calendar and pushing meetings to the afternoon.

label: Macro vs weighted F1
text: Should we report macro-F1 or weighted F1 for the intent classifier? Refunds are only 4% of tickets, so weighted F1 looks great at 0.91 while refunds quietly get worse.

label: Truncation bug found
text: I found part of the classifier bug: the new export pipeline truncates tickets at 128 tokens, and refund tickets run long because people paste whole order emails. The word 'refund' often lands after the cut.

label: Rough code review
text: The code review on my feature-store backfill PR went badly. Carlos left 31 comments, mostly about naming, plus 'did you test this at all?' I had, just not on the full table. I felt sick for the rest of the afternoon.

label: Reviewable PRs
text: I want my PRs to be easy to review: under 300 lines, a test plan in every description, and a run on the full dataset before I ask anyone to look.

label: Blunt, specific feedback
text: I'd rather get blunt feedback than vague feedback, as long as it's specific. What hurt with Carlos wasn't the number of comments, it was not knowing which ones actually mattered.

label: Real gain or noise
text: How do I tell whether a 2-point F1 gain on a 600-ticket eval set is real or just noise? Ren mentioned bootstrapping confidence intervals. I need to actually learn this.

label: Truncation fix shipped
text: I shipped the truncation fix: keep the first 64 and last 64 tokens instead of only the first 128. Refund recall is back to 0.79. I also started a small eval script so we stop comparing confusion matrices by screenshot in Slack.

label: A better standup
text: I gave the classifier-fix update in standup and people asked real follow-up questions. I still felt like I was faking it, just less than usual.

label: No laptop after 9pm
text: No laptop after 9pm on weeknights. I keep 'just checking one run' at midnight and it's wrecking my sleep.

label: Notebooks vs .py files
text: Notebooks are fine for poking around, but anything that ships goes in a .py file with tests. I learned that one the hard way in August.

label: Suggested-reply pilot
text: I paired with Jonah on the suggested-reply button in the support inbox. I did the ranking, he did the UI. We merged it Friday behind a flag for three pilot customers.

label: Watching a real user
text: I watched a recording of a support agent at one of the pilot shops using suggested replies. She clicked the second suggestion, said 'oh, nice,' and moved on. I rewatched it about four times.

label: Speed vs quality
text: On today's customer call nobody mentioned accuracy. They just want suggestions to show up before they finish typing. How much model quality would I trade for 200ms?

label: Weekend routing panel
text: I spent the weekend building a little 'why was this ticket routed here?' panel for the support team. Nobody asked for it. I showed Jonah this morning and he wants to put it in the real UI.

label: Untouched reading list
text: I realized I haven't opened my paper reading list since August. I've been too absorbed in the suggested-reply rollout to notice.

label: Six-month check-in
text: My six-month check-in with Ren, my manager, is on Tuesday. She'll ask where I want to grow over the next year, and I don't know what to say.
